notes: From this version on, after Koegaki restarts itself for a model update or to recover the microphone, an app update installed later opens the new version instead of leaving it waiting unseen in the background. When Koegaki restarts itself, for a model update or to recover the microphone, it now gives changes made in Settings time to save first. If a change cannot be saved when you choose Restart now for a model update, Koegaki says so and does not restart. If Koegaki restarts itself for a model update or to recover the microphone and the new copy cannot launch, the one you were using now keeps running instead of closing.
